notes: RShadowMap and RReflection: RViewCamera is a base class, not an embedded member (the derived ctor overwrites the vptr at +0 after RViewCamera::RViewCamera runs on this). RShadowMap also inherits USingleton<RShadowMap> (second vptr at Xbox +0x4c: 0x18beb0 then 0x192fc8; PS2 +0x58). RReflection has no USingleton vtable on either build although it has fgThis/Get.
PS2 RShadowMap leaves +0x5c unaccessed between the USingleton vptr (+0x58) and privateData (+0x60); probably padding or an unused word on the GCC side. Xbox has no gap.
RVehicleParticle Xbox ctor a6de0 has a garbled 3-parameter signature in Ghidra; it takes one stack arg (RET 0x4), the PVehicle*.

RGlareManager AddGlare a9c10 is AddGlare(CARP::GlareData&, float) with the float unused (RET 0x8); 'Glare' in Ghidra signatures is the 64-byte GlareData copy. The Glare placeholder is 0x40; if a Glare type already exists with another size, use byte[8192] for glares[].
RGlareManager 'Glare ID' attribute (0x1931c4) is registered via 38190 with max 0x4f and current-index global 0x209d24; the per-type attributes pass stride 0x40, so they edit glareTypes[glareId].
RVehicle offsets match PS2 exactly (derived-class fields after a vptr-last base); the only width difference is bool +0x360 (1 byte Xbox, 4 bytes PS2).
RVehicle +0x238/+0x248/+0x258 arrays are named from PS2 ComputeWheels/PostLoad LEAs only; Xbox ComputeWheels 96060 was not disassembled.

RShadowMap::Init 8beb0 and RGlareManager::Init 8b850 sit in a block of subsystem Init functions far from their classes' other methods; 8b850 checked (FastAlloc 0x3440 + ctor + store fgThis), names look right.
